name: Linali Andrea
tagline: Womenswear designer · Sri Lanka · Slow craft
manifesto: I strongly believe that fashion is the best form of self expression.

bio.text: Linali Andrea is a Sri Lankan womenswear designer and recent graduate. Her collections are built by hand, with Dumbara weaving, crochet, macramé, hand embroidery and reconstructed denim, and each one carries an emotional subject: healing, motherhood, slowing down, renewal.
